about: One edit unit in idea-mara, started by the writer's comment under the line: it corrects the step count. The batch check approves it. The real Edit guard raises writer-line-edited on b1-u1. b1-u1 is approved and its trigger kind is `comment`, so the flag skips the migration-verifier's flags call and the change stands: `act` at pointed writes no verify-flags.json and, with nothing else left, goes straight to acted with next_check null (no note changed). `close` needs no second check. The handled list gets the edited line as `edited` and the comment as `comment`. The log opens with 'Nothing needs you.' and lists the edit under Other edits you asked for, naming the trigger's comment, in the words a flag judged asked for gets.
spec: spec-run-manager.md 05 item 8; 04 item 22 (the `act` row at pointed); 07.3 item 2 entry 4; 11 item 101
spec-edit-guard.md 06 item 1 ('On an approved unit, skipped')
readings: No verify-flags.json is written. The runner can't check a file's absence, so the open run's step is the check: `act` at pointed reaching `acted` means nothing went to the call.
flags-1.json is the real Edit guard's output on this case's state, taken by running the steps on 2026-10-23.

Log wording (plan-run-manager.md 06 item 14, reading 1): exactly one comment in the unit's piece holds the trigger's text, so the entry quotes that comment whole, %% marks included, with its note, as a judged flag's line does. Tightened 2026-10-23.
